description: Model and EPANET Extension for Junction Mixing and Water Quality Simulation in Water Distribution System is a model or code deposit deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Yu Shao. This is the EPANET extension, named EPANET-ZJU, for junction mixing and water quality simulation in water distribution system. It is developed based on the EPANET software. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
